brief: A new song about riding the night bus home, in the spirit of the reference song but with its own words and images.
referenceLyrics:
[Verse 1]
The last bus home is running late again,
I count the puddles shining in the rain,
the driver nods like he's seen me before,
I take the seat beside the folding door.

[Chorus]
Last bus home, last bus home,
through the city on my own,
every window tells a story,
on the last bus home.

[Verse 2]
A nurse is sleeping in her hospital blue,
a boy is writing words he can't say to you,
the street lights flicker past us one by one,
and none of us can say where the night has gone.

[Chorus]
Last bus home, last bus home,
through the city on my own,
every window tells a story,
on the last bus home.
title: N29
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Top deck, front seat, I'm a captain of the dark,
we sail past shuttered chip shops and the gates of Finsbury Park,
a couple shares a kebab like it's a candlelit affair,
and someone's left a balloon tied to the handrail of the stair.

[Chorus]
Ride the N29, ride it to the end,
the city's half asleep and every stranger is a friend,
ride the N29, the long way round,
the softest kind of lonely sound.

[Verse 2]
The heater's breathing warm against my ankles and my knees,
I write a little poem on the window with my sleeve,
the stop before my stop, I always think I'll stay,
then I ring the bell and let the bus go on its way.

[Chorus]
Ride the N29, ride it to the end,
the city's half asleep and every stranger is a friend,
ride the N29, the long way round,
the softest kind of lonely sound.
reason: Same theme as the reference, as the brief asks, but every line, image and character is new.
